nina_prod: Quick sync — we need to finalize prioritization for the smart routing/fallback policy. Customer asks from two enterprise trials: predictable latency for paid tiers, and graceful cost-aware fallback during spikes. Who can help scope acceptance criteria?

sam_eng: I can take ownership of buckets + acceptance tests. Proposing these ACs:
- must prefer same-region tier when capacity available
- fallback only to compatible quantized or distilled variants (no ABI mismatch)
- latency tail (p95) stays within SLA when policy active
- no semantic regressions on core prompt set (define eval harness)

maria_pm: Add customer asks: payg = best-effort (no hard SLA), enterprise = 3-tier affinity + guaranteed fallback within +250ms latency budget. Also call out billing visibility for fallbacks.

ben_platform: Need a compatibility matrix early. Prototype config sketch below:
```
{"policy": "tiered", "tiers": ["enterprise","standard","burst"], "compat_map": {"redwood-gptx-1": ["redwood-gptx-1-q4","redwood-gptx-1-distill"]}}
```
Will start a sheet with supported variants.

jiwon_sre: Edge cases we must capture: region partition (e.g. AZ failure -> us-west-2 partial outage) — cross-region fallback only if KMS key policy allows rewrap; KMS rewrap latency can blow SLO. KV cache invalidation when switching model variants (cache key semantics). Also abusive traffic bursts that trigger fallback loops.

oliver_research: For "no semantic regressions" we need an eval harness (small seed set + automated scoring). Recommend thresholds: semantic similarity >= 0.92 (BLEU/ROUGE/emb-sim hybrid) and hallucination delta < 2% vs baseline. We'll also add a smoke classification check for hallucination.

deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging/policy-service @ci-run-42 :rocket:

nina_prod: Proposed launch gates (must pass all):
1) config schema + compat matrix reviewed by Platform
2) unit + e2e tests green in staging (including KV invalidation tests)
3) perf run: p95 latency under 1.2x baseline for enterprise route in staging
4) eval regressions within thresholds on canonical prompt set
5) docs updated + runbook + support playbook published
6) at least one pilot customer signed for beta

sam_eng: Timeline I can commit to: PRD + prototype config by Tue, staging e2e tests by Fri, perf run next Mon. Need an extra pair of eyes for the KV invalidation tests and cross-region KMS behavior.

maria_pm: Prioritization ask: if perf risk looks high we ship as Q3 beta to pilots; if low risk we push to Q3 GA. Action: collect 3 pilot customers who want early access.

ben_platform: I'll populate the compat matrix spreadsheet this afternoon with known quantized builds and legacy variants. Will link in RFC.

jiwon_sre: I'll draft the failure-mode runbook entries (KMS rewrap, cross-region fallback, model-mismatch rollbacks) and include mitigation steps and telemetry to surface.

nina_prod: @oliver_research can you own the eval harness and share a baseline artifact by EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:

oliver_research: Yes — will share a small benchmark, scoring script, and ~30 sample prompts.

sam_eng: tagging infra ask: @ben_platform please allocate a small dedicated pool for testing quantized variants so we don't affect shared capacity. Also need a quick script to rotate compat flags.

ben_platform: ack — will carve out a 2-GPU pool and add a feature flag endpoint.

nina_prod: Risks on my list: performance regressions from fallback conversions, billing transparency, and runbook complexity. We'll triage blockers in Monday sync and aim to file a short RFC after PRD draft.

maria_pm: One more ask — include a small UX snippet for customers showing expected behavior when fallback occurs (e.g., banner + reason + cost delta).

jiwon_sre: Noted. I'll add observability hooks: fallback_reason tag, original_model, fallback_model, latency_delta_ms, and a critical alert if fallback rate > 5% for enterprise tenants.

nina_prod: Thanks all — next steps: sam to push PRD draft, ben to start matrix, oliver to share eval baseline. If no objections I'll book a focused 45m triage on Monday.

sam_eng: No objections.

ben_platform: No objections.

jiwon_sre: No objections.

oliver_research: No objections.

maria_pm: +1

deploy-bot: staging run started: ci-run-42 -> policy-service/staging (tests queued)
